status: frozen-protocol; no browser campaign has run or passed

foundation.dependency_state: approved by the operator on 2026-10-21; @playwright/test 1.64.1 is a root devDependency (plans/harness-runtime-p4-playwright-dependency-plan.md)
foundation.no_second_browser_lifecycle: the Playwright Test runner is the only browser lifecycle, artifact, and report path

execution.reporters: playwright.config.mjs owns the reporters: console list output plus the JSON report that is the campaign evidence. A --reporter flag on the command line replaces that whole array and suppresses the JSON report, so the recorded command carries no override and must be run as recorded.
execution.durable_readback: each journey asserts persisted API state, not only rendered state
execution.privacy: no credentials, raw environment values, or private document contents in screenshots, reports, or artifacts; traces stay off

exit_contract.0: every selected journey passed in this run
exit_contract.1: at least one journey failed or produced no verdict
exit_contract.2: the lane could not run (preflight blocked, dependency absent, or server unavailable)

denominator_rule: Every journey below is required and stays in the browser denominator. Missing, blocked, interrupted, not_run, and unscored journeys remain countable. A journey that passed only after an earlier failed attempt is flaky, which is not a clean pass.
attempt_rule: A retry appends attempt+1 for the same journey_id and never removes the earlier attempt. Journeys, not HTTP requests or events, are the counted unit.

integration_gates.P4: this protocol and a passing browser-lane preflight
integration_gates.P5: thread projection, snapshot/cursor, and event delivery (required by B01, B02, B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B08, B09, B10, B11)
integration_gates.P6: parser adoption and attachment readiness (required by B09)
integration_gates.P7: Runtime API, targeted cancellation, and lifecycle (required by B01, B02, B03, B05, B06, B08, B09, B11)
integration_gates.P3: only when a journey explicitly observes a tool outcome; none of the journeys below asserts one
integration_gates.P10_freeze: only for a journey that opts into a P10 rubric; none of the journeys below declares one

journeys.action: complete three consecutive turns, return home, reopen the same thread, complete three more turns
visible_observations: all six answers and their citations remain visible after the home round trip and reopen
message order matches the order the turns were submitted
durable_observations: thread identity is the same before and after the home round trip
persisted messages match the rendered order and content

journeys.action: start two threads concurrently and let them finish in the reverse order from their start
visible_observations: each thread shows only its own answer and loading state
the thread selected last keeps its projection while the other finishes
durable_observations: both threads reach terminal durable state
no late event for either thread overwrites the other

journeys.action: refresh and reconnect during an in-flight run
visible_observations: the run resumes from a retained replay or the current snapshot without losing committed content
partial token output is never rendered as a completed answer
durable_observations: the browser state after recovery matches the durable snapshot

journeys.action: force a replay/reset path by requesting an unprovable event cursor
visible_observations: the client replaces its projection only with a snapshot at least as new as its current revision
the view never regresses to older content after reset
durable_observations: the snapshot the client adopts matches the durable revision

journeys.action: double-activate send, press Enter plus click, and retry after a lost response
visible_observations: the UI converges on the original outcome instead of showing two answers
a changed payload for the same intent reports a conflict
durable_observations: one durable accepted operation and one logical run exist for the intent
HTTP attempt count exceeds the logical operation count

journeys.action: request explicit cancellation of the active run while a late completion is released at a barrier
visible_observations: the cancelled run shows its terminal cancelled state
the late completion does not replace the terminal state
durable_observations: cancellation ownership is recorded against the exact run
no second operation is created by the late completion

journeys.action: corrupt the local snapshot, serve a stale GET for a newer thread, and resolve a genuinely absent thread
visible_observations: a malformed local snapshot does not erase newer state
a stale GET response cannot overwrite a newer revision
an absent thread is shown as not found
durable_observations: the surviving rendered state matches the durable newest revision

journeys.action: inject a transient 5xx and a timeout on thread read, then a real absent thread
visible_observations: the 5xx and the timeout render as retryable error states
only the genuinely absent thread renders as not found
durable_observations: the retry after the transient failure reads the unchanged durable thread

journeys.action: upload, prepare, reach ready, and produce a parser failure on one thread while another thread completes a turn
visible_observations: upload failure, accepted/preparing, ready, and parser-failure states each render truthfully
ready appears only after the required adoption, indexing, and readiness work commits
the unrelated thread stays usable throughout
durable_observations: each displayed attachment state matches the durable lifecycle state after a refresh
a stale result never associates with replaced or deleted content

journeys.action: subscribe two tabs to the same run
visible_observations: each tab receives the complete event sequence
each tab keeps its own answer, loading state, attachment, and trace projection
durable_observations: both tabs converge on the same durable terminal state

journeys.action: exercise the existing TaskPanel trace read states: off, local, external, unreadable
visible_observations: all four trace states remain distinct in the panel
an empty span list is not rendered as a failed turn
durable_observations: session records stay readable with tracing off
an exporter failure leaves the completed turn readable through the receipt fallback
no raw session text appears in trace artifacts
browser trace state never supplies a mechanism metric denominator
